name: aoknotes-monorepo
description: AOKnotes — Local-first cross-platform notes app (Web, Mobile, Personal PC Sync & Pluggable Cloud)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@aoknotes/core && npm run build --workspace=@aoknotes/pc-daemon && npm run build --workspace=@aoknotes/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@aoknotes/core && npm run test --workspace=@aoknotes/pc-daemon
